title: What basic information will I need when I apply?
content: When applying for FEMA assistance, FEMA asks for: your address with ZIP code; the condition of your damaged home, if known; insurance information, if available; Social Security number; a phone number where you can be contacted; an address where you can get mail or an email address to receive electronic notifications; annual household income; and account information if you would like assistance provided through direct deposit. Sensitive information such as a Social Security number or bank account should only be entered on the official FEMA or DisasterAssistance.gov application, never shared with third parties.
required_information: Condition of your damaged home, if known
Social Security number (enter only on the official FEMA/DisasterAssistance.gov application)
Phone number where you can be contacted
Mailing address or email for notifications
Direct deposit account information, optional (official application only)
next_action: Gather what you can from this checklist before applying. Enter sensitive details only on the official FEMA or DisasterAssistance.gov application.
